page.overview:
Who is Silvane Redfor?

Silvane Redford is an Aes Sedai of the Green Ajah., Silvane Redfor}}

Silvane is very weak in the One Power with a strength level of .

Silvane was one of the sisters in Cadsuane Melaidhrin's group in Cairhien.

When Cadsuane went to Far Madding searching for Rand, she left Silvane and other sisters to keep an eye on the situation in Cairhien, under the leadership of Samitsu Tamagowa.
